maddeler.e:
تنتبهون (form VIII)
# تَنْتَبِهُونَ (tantabihūna) /tan.ta.bi.huː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
# تُنْتَبَهُونَ (tuntabahūna) /tun.ta.ba.huː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَبَهَ (intabaha)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
